definitions.brier: sum squared prediction error / supported initial eligible forecasts
definitions.coverage: non-abstaining decision windows / all decision windows
definitions.ece: fixed four bins; unsupported excluded and separately counted
definitions.interval: descriptive Wilson sensitivity, synthetic non-iid; no coverage guarantee
definitions.net: benefit_units*useful_effect-cost-risk; frozen synthetic truth even for UNKNOWN delivery
definitions.opportunity_cost: best current eligible positive net at terminal refusal; local, not sequential regret
definitions.value: normative units, not real business risk or information gain

prediction_support_denominator: Initial hard-eligible forecasts, not all candidate outcomes: validation 10 supported +5 unsupported=15; challenge 27+17=44. Brier/ECE exclude unsupported and disclose counts.
ece_formula: sum over 4 fixed bins abs(predicted_sum-positive_sum) / supported_N; bin counts/sums in comparison.prediction_quality
interpretation: No evidence of real-world calibration, interval coverage, or decision superiority. Bounded challenge net25 < point47 < v3 65 < B0 94; misses8 and opportunity cost63. Synthetic costs/utility only.
